title: How to prompt AI for a step-by-step "Lego instruction booklet" for level design?
author: GoodLumpy9908
selftext: "Hi everyone. I have an AI-generated map prototype and I want to build it in Unity. I'm looking for the right AI prompt to generate a visual, step-by-step assembly guide—just like a Lego instruction manual. The output needs to show the exact asset counts (e.g., 'X amount of this piece') and visual instructions on how they snap together. Any prompt ideas?"

comments.author: radgh
comments.body: Generate a prompt to generate a prompt that generates a prompt for you
